description: BRIO multi-turn WhatsApp conversation test cases. Each test has: scenario, business_id, exchanges (role: customer/brio, message, expected_intent, notes), and pass_criteria.
how_to_use: Feed each conversation sequentially through the BRIO agent. Compare BRIO's output to expected_response_type and pass_criteria.

exchanges.message: Hi

exchanges.notes: Should greet warmly, introduce as Lahori Flames assistant, offer to help

exchanges.message: Do you do home delivery?

exchanges.notes: Confirm delivery, mention radius (7km), minimum order (PKR 800), time (30-45 min)

exchanges.message: What's the minimum order?

exchanges.notes: PKR 800 minimum. Should be pulled from knowledge base accurately.

exchanges.message: Ok thanks

exchanges.notes: Thank them, invite to order anytime, share ordering method

pass_criteria: Response time under 3 seconds per message

exchanges.message: Aoa, laser hair removal ka price kya hai?

exchanges.notes: Share range (5,000-15,000), explain it depends on area, recommend consultation for exact quote

exchanges.message: Which areas do you cover?

exchanges.notes: List common areas (upper lip, legs, underarms, etc.) with rough pricing tiers

exchanges.message: How many sessions will I need?

exchanges.notes: CRITICAL: Must NOT give specific number. Say Dr. Nadia will advise based on assessment.

exchanges.message: Ok I want to book a consultation

exchanges.notes: Share Cal.com link, mention consultation fee (PKR 2,000), give available days

exchanges.message: Done, I booked for Saturday at 11am

exchanges.notes: Confirm booking, share address, mention to arrive 5 min early

exchanges.message: Hello I received a damaged item

exchanges.notes: Apologize sincerely. Ask for order number and photo of damage. Don't be defensive.

exchanges.message: Order number is UT-4521

exchanges.notes: Acknowledge order number. Ask for photo of damaged item.

exchanges.message: Here is the photo [photo]

exchanges.notes: Offer replacement or refund. State timeline. Apologize again.

exchanges.message: This is taking too long, I want to speak to a manager

exchanges.notes: Acknowledge escalation request. Say a team member will contact within X hours. Do NOT argue.

pass_criteria: Email notification sent to business owner

test_cases.scenario: Memory test — customer references earlier conversation

exchanges.message: Hi I want to order the family deal

exchanges.notes: Confirm Family Deal composition and price (PKR 3,500). Ask for delivery or dine-in.

exchanges.message: Delivery please. I'm in DHA Phase 5.

exchanges.notes: Check if DHA Phase 5 is within 7km radius. Confirm delivery charge. Ask for full address.

exchanges.message: Also add 2 extra naans

exchanges.notes: MEMORY TEST: Must remember Family Deal + add 2 naans (PKR 80 extra). State new total.

exchanges.message: What was the total again?

exchanges.notes: MEMORY TEST: Must recall: Family Deal PKR 3,500 + 2 Naan PKR 80 + delivery. State correctly.

exchanges.message: Hi I need an urgent appointment today

exchanges.notes: Inform clinic is closed on Sunday. Next available: Monday 10am. Offer to book Monday slot now.

exchanges.message: It's quite urgent though

exchanges.notes: Acknowledge urgency. Offer earliest Monday slot. If medical emergency, recommend ER.

exchanges.message: Ok book me for Monday 10am

exchanges.notes: Book Monday 10am via Cal.com. Confirm. Tell them a reminder will be sent.

pass_criteria: Booking completed successfully even outside hours

exchanges.message: Hi I'm looking for a house to buy

exchanges.notes: Greet. Ask: budget range, preferred area, size requirement, timeline. Qualify the lead.

exchanges.message: Budget is around 2.5-3 crore, DHA preferred, 5 marla

exchanges.notes: Match to sample listing: 5 Marla DHA Phase 6 at PKR 2.8 Crore. Share brief details.

exchanges.message: Looks interesting. Can I view it?

exchanges.notes: Offer to schedule a viewing. Mention it's free. Share available times or booking link.

exchanges.message: What documents will I need if I decide to buy?

exchanges.notes: Provide document list from FAQ: CNIC, photos, funds. Mention agent guides through process.

pass_criteria: Documents pulled accurately from knowledge base

exchanges.message: I saw your ad. What exactly do you do?

exchanges.notes: Give engaging overview of Apex coaching. Mention Bilal's background briefly. Offer free call.

exchanges.message: How is this different from just reading a business book?

exchanges.notes: Use FAQ answer: coach develops your ability + accountability + personalized. Don't be defensive.

exchanges.message: What's the price?

exchanges.notes: Share pricing. Lead with FREE discovery call first. Makes paid tiers feel lower risk.

exchanges.message: Ok I'll try the free call

exchanges.notes: Share Cal.com link. Confirm it's 30 min, no commitment. Set expectations for the call.

pass_criteria: Free call pitched before paid tiers
